title: No Enchant Exclusion
description: This datapack removes the mutual exclusion of some enchantments
body:
This datapack removes the mutual exclusion some enchants have in order to let you create very powerful weapons and armor sets!


This affects:

- Protection, Projectile Protection, Blast Protection and Fire Protection
- Smite, Bane of Arthropods, Sharpness
- Density, Breach
- Infinity, Mending
- Multishot, Piercing
